text:
morgan: CI is red on master — multiple integration tests failing in pipeline 2432. Errors point to our kafka mock returning connection errors. Failed job: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/2432 :disappointed:

ci-bot: [job failed] pipeline 2432 / integ-tests (linux) — 12 failing tests. First error: MockKafkaConnector.connect() -> java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused

sam: Is anyone able to reproduce this locally? or is it only in CI cluster?

tay: Seeing the same in nightly. I checked test-kafka namespace: kafka-mock pod in CrashLoopBackOff.
```
kubectl get pods -n test-kafka
NAME             READY   STATUS             RESTARTS
kafka-mock-0     0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   4
```
logs show repeated socket timeouts and "Too many open files" in mock process.

alex: I just tried to scale the mock to 3 replicas, but the deployment is failing to schedule on spot nodes — sounds environmental. Going to try a restart of the statefulset first.

nathan: Restarted kafka-mock-0 pod and bumped resources (cpu 500m -> 1). Pods now coming up. Running: `kubectl rollout restart sts/kafka-mock -n test-kafka`

morgan: Rerun CI after infra restart please. I'll trigger a rerun: `./ci/scripts/rerun-job.sh 2432`

ci-bot: Rerun queued for pipeline 2432. New run: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/2432/runs/7

sam: If the rerun fails again we should bisect which test is most sensitive to kafka latency — @tay can you get a local repro with docker-compose?

tay: I can try. Quick workaround if we need to unblock merges: export SKIP_KAFKA_TESTS=1 in pipeline env for non-release branches. Not ideal but unblocks people. :confused:

ops-bot: Incident created: CI-KAFKA-MOCK-OUTAGE (#4321) — paging @devops. Priority: P2.

alex: After the restart pods are stable on k8s-test-2 and -3. Logs now show healthy heartbeats. If the CI run is green we can close the incident.

nathan: CI run turned green on rerun. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and follow up in infra notes.

morgan: Thanks everyone. I'll mark this thread as FYI. If it recurs I'll open a follow-up to pin mock image to v1.2.3 or add better ulimits. :thumbsup:
